newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank sets 2 bln yuan Beijing airport loans.
newsitem.headline: China bank sets 2 bln yuan Beijing airport loans.

text.p: The State Development Bank has granted loans worth two billion yuan ($240 million) for an expansion of Beijing's airport, the official China Daily said on Friday.
The loans, which include 500 million yuan of low interest credits, would be repaid over 13 years, the newspaper said.
The loan accord, signed earlier this week, marks the biggest credit given by the bank, which funds strategic projects, to the aviation sector.
The expansion of Beijing's Capital Airport is set to cost 9.18 billion yuan and is also the largest aviation project under the state's 1996-2000 five-year economic plan.
It calls for construction of a new terminal building, additional warehousing space and car park facilities and is expected to be operational in 1999.
The airport will have an hourly capacity of 12,000 to 13,000 passengers after the expansion compared with 2,500 to 3,000 per hour now.
Annual capacity will be 35 million passengers and 440,000 tonnes of freight, the newspaper said without giving further details.
